title: Concerning the Twelve Signs of the Zodiac and the Five Stars
text:
⟨p.166⟩
69
69. Concerning the Twelve Zodiac-signs. 69
Also, with the Five Stars.
Once again, at one of the times, while the apostle {6}
⟨p.167⟩
In the gathering, a disciple stood fast on his feet before him, drew near
to him (and) said to him: 'We beseech thee, our Lord, that thou declare
unto us and reveal to us forth concerning the twelve zodiac-signs
that are set in the sphere — are they joined one to another, or do they each belong to a
place according to their substance? Or rather, is it the five stars that circle
in their midst — are they from outside? Or what — has the Demiurge appointed them
to be powers and way-leaders, that is to say — has the great
establisher who has appointed all the creation, bound them and hung
them within the sphere?'
Therefore we beseech thee, our
Lord, that thou mayst persuade our heart concerning these (matters) hidden from every man.'
{1} he said to that disciple who had drawn near: 'Whether
these twelve zodiac-signs that are hung in the sphere, or these five
stars that circle among them — these and these, all the archons
are, according to their substance, all enemies and adversaries to
one another, plundering one another through the energeia of the great
artisan who has shaped all the worlds, and bound
{2}, has fettered them in the sphere of the upper place that circles every
time. The hour, then, when she circles and casts them about, they do indeed every work
that pleases them above and below, according to their purpose
of heart. But there are stewards over them; there are demanders of
the upper place over them, to compel them, to demand from them, to take what is theirs
from their hands.
This, then, is the manner that befits to know — that they
{3} out of the five worlds of the Darkness, and were bound in the
{4}, and took two zodiac-signs per world. The Twins
{5} the Archer belong to the world of the Smoke, that is
the Mind. The Ram itself with the Lion belong to the
world of the Fire. The Bull, the Water-Bearer and the Scales
{6} to the world of the Wind. The Crab and the Virgin
{7} {8} belong to the world of the Water. The Goat-Horn
{9} the Scorpion belong to the world of the Darkness. These are
{10} archons of Wickedness — those whom the wicked-
{11}. For they are the doer of every evil and
{12} {13}cosmos, whether in the tree or in the flesh
⟨p.168⟩
(...) Moreover, again concerning these five stars, the way-leaders: namely, that they were fashi-
-oned in what place. The star indeed of Zeus, they begot it forth
from the world of Smoke — which is mind. Aphro-
-dite herself, she came forth from the world of Fire. A-
-res himself is reckoned to the world of Wind. Hermes
is reckoned to the world of Water, while Kronos is reckoned to the world
{0}Darkness. But the two Anabibazons themselves are reckoned to
Fire and Pleasure — which are the Dry-One and the Abomi-
-nation; they are the Father and the Mother of all these. The Sun
{1}, with the Moon, were brought in with them by a
craft, that they may reign over them and bind them about, being wreathed around them at
every hour. These seven that we have proclaimed — the five stars and the An-
-abibazons, the two — they are the makers of evil, who do every
evil and wickedness in every region of the All — the upper
place and the lower place, in every creature, in the Dry-One
and the Abomination, in the tree and in the flesh.
Once again I reveal forth to you concerning the zodiac-signs: that {2}
spread forth, fastened in four sides, three to a corner, in
these four places, and they are joined to the surrounding sphere. Ari{3}
Leo, Sagittarius — they are the three reckoned to one and the same
side. Taurus himself, Capricorn with Vir{4}
— these other three are reckoned to another side. But Gemini himself,
Libra with Aquarius — reckoned to another side. Scorp{5}
-io, Pisces with Cancer — reckoned to another lot. {6}They
are placed therefore in this manner, fastened to the four sides, spread for{7}
in the sphere. The time, indeed, when they shall plunder along the side of Ar{8}
-ies, Leo, Leo, with Sagittarius — by means of the stew-
-ard who is upon him, who measures him, with the way-leaders {9}
are mounted upon him, in those very ones — an affliction str{10}
-ikes upon all the cattle of the dry land below, thus.
But the time itself when they shall plunder {11} of Tau{12}
Virgo with Capricorn — {13}
⟨p.169⟩
they come into being at that hour in the ripenings, and with the figs and with
all the fruits of the trees. But the time, again, in which they shall
plunder is at the side of Scorpio, of Pisces, and of Cancer:
a diminishing comes about in the waters upon the earth
of a year-of-failure, coming about in every place; while they
plunder also at the side of Gemini, Libra, and
Aquarius: a lack and a diminishing come about in
the imprint of humanity in every place.
Behold then, I have raised you up forth concerning the {0}
zodiac-signs, that they were molded from the five
worlds of the Darkness; they were bound in the sphere. I have taught
you also concerning the other five stars, that they too came into being
from the five worlds of the land of {1}Darkness. I have proclaimed
to you also concerning the {2}two anabibazons, that they stand fast
upon the mystery of the Fire and the Pleasure, which they
are: the Dry one and the Moist one, the Father and the Mother.
I have revealed forth to you also concerning the sun and the moon, that they are not
strangers to them, but on account of the necessity of the economy
— that the work takes light upon him, and that they are reckoned to plunder
there. Because of this they were reckoned in among them according to the count of
the number; since the sun and
the moon are out of the dominion, not being reckoned with the stars and the zodiac-signs.
